name: University of Leeds

facts.text: Established in 1904, the University of Leeds is one of the largest universities in the UK, with more than 37,000 students.
The Leeds campus is a short walk from Leeds City Centre.
Leeds is part of the Russell Group of research-intensive universities and is ranked in the top 100 universities in the world (QS World University Rankings 2027).
Leeds has won the Queen's Anniversary Prize three times and its staff hold 33 National Teaching Fellowships.
The university contributed £1.9 billion to the Leeds City Region economy in 2021/22.

sources.title: Applying for a Student visa: Application step-by-step guide | University of Leeds
topics: Reasons for studying in the UK and at Leeds
sources.notes: Describes the UKVI credibility interview only: 'Anyone applying for a Student visa from outside the UK can be interviewed as part of their visa application', conducted by a UKVI caseworker to check 'if you are a genuine student and that your English ability is at the correct level'. Advice: 'Be prepared to explain your thought process in detail and provide specific examples' and 'We recommend that you ask for a copy of the interview transcript at the end.' 'The issue of a CAS does not guarantee a successful application.' No university-run pre-CAS interview, CAS Shield or Enroly mentioned. Search snippet: CAS can be issued no earlier than six months before the course start date.
